verdict.headline: NOT YET - no statistically clear edge; the fix behaves like an ordinary price level so far.
details: At the fix level price bounced 36% of the time (367 touches) vs 41% at placebo levels (-4 pts, p=0.1112).
Magnet beta: fix 0.0047 (t=0.39) vs placebo 0.0051 (t=0.51). Negative = price pulled back toward the level.
